A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed a new nodal classification for non-small-cell carcinoma of the lung based on the number of lymph node metastases (N) and on the ratio of metastases (R), and we have demonstrated that this new nodal classification is more accurate for predicting survival than the current nodal classification.

we have proposed new nodal classifications (NLC) for non-small-cell carcinoma (NSCLC) based on the number or ratio of metastatic nodes, and we have shown that the new NLC is superior to the existing TNM NLC.
